parts.text: Y and solution Z were analysed. tests on solution Y tests observations Solution Y was divided into four portions in four test‑tubes. test 1 A strip of universal indicator paper was dipped into the first portion of solution Y . the universal indicator paper turned blue test 2 Aqueous copper( II ) sulfate was added to the second portion of solution Y . a blue precipitate formed test 3 A flame test was done using the third portion of solution Y . a red flame was seen test 4 2 cm 3 of dilute sulfuric acid was added to the fourth portion of solution Y . no visible change; the test-tube became slightly warmer

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) 3 of dilute hydrochloric acid was added to the first portion of solution Z in a boiling tube. The mixture was warmed and a piece of filter paper soaked in acidified aqueous potassium manganate( VII ) held at the mouth of the boiling tube. VII ).

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) 3 of dilute hydrochloric acid followed by a few drops of aqueous barium nitrate were added to the third portion of solution Z . observations ......................................................................................................................... [1]
